mentions.name: AI Piano Practice Voice Agent
mentions.description: This project explores highly interactive piano practice by running a full duplex AI voice agent alongside the student's practice session, using AI to help students practice their instrument better.
mentions.problem: Students need better support to practice their instrument effectively.
mentions.audience: Piano/instrument students practicing on their own
mentions.source_excerpt: Exploring highly interactive instrument (piano) practice to see if AI can help students practice better. Full duplex voice agent alongside your practice session.
